Freelance Rate Calculator

Derive your hourly freelance rate from your income goal, billable hours and a buffer for taxes and downtime.

The buffer is a rough margin for taxes, admin work and gaps between clients — adjust it to your situation.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter your target annual take-home income.
  2. Enter your billable hours per week and working weeks per year.
  3. Add a buffer % for taxes and non-billable time.
  4. Read your hourly, 8-hour day and weekly rates.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is the hourly rate calculated?

Your target income is marked up by the buffer percentage, then divided by total billable hours per year (billable hours/week × working weeks/year). The buffer is meant to cover taxes, unpaid admin time, sick days and client gaps.

What should I use for the buffer %?

The buffer is a safety margin added on top of your target income. 25–40% is a common starting point to cover income tax and non-billable time.

Does it give day and week rates too?

Yes — the 8-hour day rate and weekly rate are just the hourly rate multiplied out, so they stay consistent.
